summary: Completed testing of three new Project Management features: 1) List View, 2) Subtask Assignment, 3) Recurring Tasks. All features are working correctly in both backend and frontend. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components functional via Playwright.

issues: Accessibility warnings: DialogContent missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby (non-blocking, accessibility improvement recommended)

backend_tests: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/tasks returns tasks with sortable fields (name, status, priority, due_date)
Tasks include enriched fields: assigned_to_name, labels, subtask_count
Single task detail endpoint works for modal
frontend_tests: View toggle buttons (Kanban/List/Calendar) present and functional
List view shows table with columns: Task Name, Status, Priority, Assignee, Due Date, Labels
Sort headers clickable - Name, Status, Priority, Due Date columns sortable
Clicking task row opens TaskDetailModal correctly

backend_tests: POST /api/projects/subtasks creates subtask with assigned_to field
GET subtasks returns assigned_to_name for display
frontend_tests: Subtask input field allows adding new subtasks
Each subtask has 'Assign' dropdown showing all users
User list includes: Admin User, Super Administrator, Test Users, Marketing Manager, etc.

backend_tests: PUT /api/projects/tasks/{id} accepts is_recurring, recurrence_pattern, recurrence_interval fields
Task can be set to daily/weekly/monthly/yearly patterns
When recurring task marked 'completed', create_next_recurring_task() is called
New task created with calculated next due date
New task preserves: name, assignee, priority, labels, is_recurring settings
frontend_tests: Edit mode shows 'Repeat' button in task header row
Recurring indicator badge shows pattern (e.g., 'Daily') next to due date
Popover opens with toggle for enabling recurring
Pattern options available: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly
Interval and end date fields available in popover

critical_code_review_comments: List View implementation is clean - uses useMemo for efficient sorting, proper column definitions
Subtask assignment uses Select component with user list correctly passed from parent
Recurring task logic in backend properly uses python-dateutil for date calculations
Frontend recurring UI in TaskDetailModal Edit mode is well-structured with Popover component
Minor accessibility issue: DialogContent needs DialogTitle wrapper (console warning)
seed_data_created: TEST_* prefixed tasks and subtasks created during testing
